'''2012 SoCal Grand Prix Matthew Harrison-Trainor DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] at [[2012 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Grand Prix).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Grand Prix
